text:
emma: FYI I opened a PR to harmonize the rate limits/quota wording across pricing pages, metering docs, and the dashboards. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5460

noah: Thanks. Can we adopt 'consumption unit' and 'limit window' as the canonical terms? saves a lot of crosswalk confusion.

zara: yes please. Also we need two small pricing examples: one US sample (no VAT) and one EU sample (show net + VAT). I'll add a tiny table.

kevin: SDK snippet update: v2 headers use `x-redwood-tenant` and `x-redwood-consumption-unit`. I'll push curl/python/js variants to the branch. small note: change the comment in snippets from "rate window" -> "limit window".

emma: added a checklist in the PR description:
- [ ] canonical terminology update
- [ ] panel id crosswalk (staging->prod)
- [ ] sdk snippets curl/python/js (v2 headers)
- [ ] 429 retry examples (exponential backoff + jitter)
- [ ] EU VAT example + i18n keys
- [ ] staging preview link

docs-bot: preview published -> https://redwood-inference-docs-staging.netlify.app/pr-5460 :rocket: 

noah: Panel mapping needed. I exported staging ids and will paste them in the PR comment; remind reviewers to open with `?env=staging` when reviewing.

zara: i18n: added EU translations and used 'billing period' per legal. Also flagged that pricing tables should include a column for gross price.

kevin: 429 JS snippet added (simple jittered backoff). curl snippet for ops coming next.

emma: CI is running `yarn docs:build` locally to sanity-check anchors. If Pipelines flake we'll split non-blocking copy nits into follow-up PRs.

noah: small editorial: rename metric to `quota_consumed_{unit}` so the docs labels match telemetry.

emma: merged minor fixes after CI green. thanks all :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR #5460 merged to main by emma
